configurations.name: backend-scratch
runtimeArgs: DATABASE_URL=$(grep '^DATABASE_URL=' backend/.env | cut -d= -f2- | sed 's#/[^/]*$#/syrh_walkthrough#') exec uv run --project backend python backend/manage.py runserver 8001

configurations.name: frontend-scratch
runtimeArgs: SYRH_API=http://127.0.0.1:8001 exec npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --port 5174 --strictPort
